name: Southern District of Florida

office_code.note: FLSB case numbers carry no office digit: LR 9004-1(e) [S17] defines the caption case number as 'xx-xxxxx-ABC ... beginning with the year, followed by the five-digit case number, followed by the assigned judge's initials', and the Clerk's Procedural Manual [S82] says 'Each case number includes the judge's initials, which corresponds to the division in which the judge is located (e.g., 25-12345-SMG)'. The CM/ECF office number (Case Upload field 10) is not published on any page read.

max_bytes.note: Clerk's Procedural Manual (06/01/2026), System Requirements and PDF Document Limitations: 'Each PDF must not exceed 50MB and have a physical size of 8.5 x 11 inches.' The FAQs [S86] agree: 'The current size limitation that CM/ECF allows for electronically filed documents, including exhibits or attachments, is 50 megabytes.' This applies to every PDF, not only exhibits as ADR 0024's row says.

text_searchable_required.note: LR 9004-1(a)(1): all documents created for filing in CM/ECF must 'be in text-searchable PDF format', with 1-inch margins, 12-point font (10-point footnotes) and double spacing; (b) exempts exhibits, scanned-signature documents under LR 5005-2, and trial exhibits. The Manual [S82] adds: convert rather than scan; documents 'should be text searchable (e.g., include Optical Character Recognition (OCR) metadata)'.

flatten_required.note: 'Flatten all interactive documents, especially this court's local form Chapter 13 plan'; also remove password protection, interactive elements and multimedia; portrait orientation; Times New Roman or Century Schoolbook preferred.

pdf_a_required.note: No FLSB page mentions PDF/A; the figure is ADR 0024's 'no launch court requires PDF/A today' [S16], not confirmed on a court page.

max_line_chars.note: CI-3 (rev. 06/01/26) Exhibit A I.(d): 'Each line must not exceed 40 characters in length'.

max_creditor_lines.note: I.(e): 'Each name and address must consist of no more than 5 (five) total lines, with one blank line between creditors'.

pad_to_lines.note: No fixed block size is stated.

name_line_chars.note: No separate name-line width; the 40-character limit applies to every line. First name first, last name last, no titles; 'Attention' or c/o on the second line.

comma_after_city.note: I.(h): ZIP on the last line with city and two-capital-letter state; the sample list writes 'Wilmington DE 19850' with no comma. Hyphen for nine-digit ZIPs. Typefaces Courier 10 Pitch, Prestige Elite or Letter Gothic; single column; no ALL CAPS.

case_number_header_when_separate.note: I.(k): 'Do not put any other information on the matrix, such as a heading, date, lines, or page numbers.' E-filing attorneys upload the matrix through Bankruptcy > Creditor Maintenance; the file is ASCII/MS-DOS text named 'creditor.txt' (Manual [S82]).

certification_required.note: CI-3 requires no certification with the initial matrix; local form LF-4 'Debtor's Notice of Compliance with Requirements for Amending Creditor Information' is required only for post-petition amendments (CI-3 II.a; LR 1007-1(b) [S17]).

value.title: Local Rule 5005-2 Signature of a Person Other than a Registered User
value.retention: 5 years after the later of discharge, dismissal, or final adjudication of appeals

signature_instrument.note: LR 5005-2(b): a non-registered person's document may be signed '/s/' plus the name, or with a scanned wet-ink image, only with authorization — for a non-user, the person 'actually signed an identical copy of the document with a wet ink signature' and the filer received it (or a copy/scan) before filing. (e)(1): the registered user 'must obtain the wet ink signature no later than 14 days after filing the document, and must retain the wet ink signature for at least 5 years after the later of' discharge, dismissal, or adjudication of all appeals. (c) allows a commercial digital signature instead. Local Rules 2026 edition, effective 2026-06-01.

ssn_statement.note: Procedural Manual, Protecting Privacy for Filings: 'Specific docket events in CM/ECF, such as the Statement of Social Security Number, will restrict the public's ability to view a PDF image. It is critical that filers select the correct event title'. The individual Chapter 7 petition package [S87] lists B121 among the documents to file.

local_forms.title: Declaration Regarding Payment Advices
local_forms.when_required: Every individual debtor, by the Bankruptcy Rule 1007(c) deadline, even if no payment advices were received (LR 1007-1(c)); listed in the individual Chapter 7 petition package

local_forms.title: Debtor's Notice of Compliance with Requirements for Amending Creditor Information
local_forms.when_required: When filing Schedules D or E/F other than with the petition, or when amending them (LR 1007-1(b)); with any post-petition addition or correction to the matrix (CI-3 II.a)

local_forms.title: Acknowledgment of Responsibility for Live Access to CM/ECF with Full Attorney Filing Privileges (rev. 06/01/26)
local_forms.when_required: Registration only, not a case filing: emailed to CMECF_Support@flsb.uscourts.gov with a concurrent PACER e-file registration

value.deadline: CM/ECF-incurred fees must be paid via Pay.gov from an attorney account by 2:00 a.m. on the day following the incurred fee
value.note: Procedural Manual, Methods of Payment: 'CM/ECF-incurred fees must be paid via Pay.gov from an attorney account by 2:00 a.m. on the day following an incurred fee. If it is not paid timely, the user's PACER credential will be placed in a lockout status'. Installments (individuals only, Form 103A): full payment within 120 days; prior-case fees must be paid first. Nothing read says whether Case Upload may be used with installments.

case_upload.note: No FLSB page read mentions Case Upload; the Procedural Manual says commercial software 'is commonly configured' to produce creditor.txt and describes the Judge/Trustee Assignment module. Verify in a training-database session (no training database is published).

training_required.note: The FAQs say 'Additional questions regarding training requirements should be submitted via email to: CMECF_support@flsb.uscourts.gov'; the CM/ECF page [S35], the registration page [S85], LF-95 [S83] and the Manual [S82] state no training prerequisite (LF-95 asks the applicant to certify review of the Local Rules and filing requirements, and optionally full CM/ECF privileges in another bankruptcy court).

registration.notes: Two-part registration: email LF-95 (attorney), LF-94 (trustee) or LF-96 (limited filer) to CMECF_Support@flsb.uscourts.gov, then submit an e-file registration from the PACER account; a public-query PACER account converts to an e-filing credential on the clerk's approval [S82, S85]. Only attorneys with FLSD bar admission get full privileges; the PACER credential must match the attorney on the document; credentials may not be shared — staff use Filing Agent credentials [S83, S82]. LR 5005-1(a)(1): a represented entity must file electronically; unrepresented individuals may not [S17]. Registration forms are rev. 06/01/26.

notes: Divisions: FLSB's divisions rule is Local Rule 1002-2(a), not 1071-1 [S17]: Miami (Miami-Dade, Monroe), Fort Lauderdale (Broward), West Palm Beach (Highlands, Indian River, Martin, Okeechobee, Palm Beach, St. Lucie) — all nine statutory counties of 28 U.S.C. § 89(c) ('Dade' = Census 'Miami-Dade', FIPS 12086) appear in exactly one division. 1002-2(b)(1): a chapter 7/11/12/13 petition 'must be filed in the division ... in which the debtor's domicile, residence, principal place of business, or principal assets are located'; the clerk may reassign wrongly filed cases. Office codes could not be verified: the court's case-number format (LR 9004-1(e); Manual) is year–five digits–judge initials with no office digit. LR 9009-1: a promulgated local form 'must be used without material alteration'. Failed URLs: https://www.flsb.uscourts.gov/court-locations (HTTP 404 — the page is /court/locations); direct curl downloads of *.uscourts.gov PDFs (CI-3, Procedural Manual, LF-95) returned HTTP 404 (bot filtering) — they were fetched with WebFetch and text-extracted with pypdf. The WebFetch summariser could not read any PDF; every PDF fact here comes from local pypdf extraction of the fetched file. The Court Locations page [S90] shows different phone numbers for Ft. Lauderdale ((954) 769-5400) and West Palm Beach ((561) 803-3400) than the homepage and the PACER lookup; phones are not recorded in this file.
